title: Servicing System Reference: Returned-Payment Fee Entries
content:
On Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts, a returned-payment fee is charged once for each borrower payment the borrower's bank returns. It is booked as a returned-payment fee entry dated the assessment date that names the returned payment and the installment it was made for, and the contract's fees due rise by the fee. A returned-payment fee not charged on the date of the return is charged on the date it is assessed.

## Capability

`assess_returned_payment_fee_ca20439d` books one returned-payment fee on the Kestrel Auto Finance loan ledger, dated today, naming the payment the bank returned and the installment that payment was made for; the contract's fees due rise by the same amount. The borrower sees the fee on the loan history and in the fees due. It records the amount it is given and decides nothing itself.

## How it is invoked

An agent-side tool: the representative unlocks `assess_returned_payment_fee_ca20439d`, then calls it with the four parameters below.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `finance_contract_id` | the reference number of the finance contract being charged, as returned by the finance contract lookup for this borrower | identifier |
| `returned_payment_id` | the ledger reference number of the borrower payment the bank returned, as shown on the original payment entry in the loan history lookup | identifier |
| `installment_due_date` | the due date of the installment the returned payment was made for, exactly as the loan history shows it | YYYY-MM-DD, no time zone |
| `returned_fee_amount` | the returned-payment fee being charged | USD, a positive amount with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent |

## Return

A successful call returns `status` "returned_payment_fee_assessed", `finance_txn_id` (the reference number of the new fee entry), `returned_payment_id` (the payment the fee is for), `returned_fee_amount` (the fee booked, USD with 2 decimals) and `fees_due` (the contract's fees due including this fee, USD with 2 decimals).

## Points of reference

- The payment named is the original payment entry the bank returned, not the return entry itself.
- One fee entry is booked per call; the borrower's loan history then shows it against that payment.
